lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੋਊ ਭਏ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੀਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gaavat sunat dooo bhae mukate jinaa guramukh khin har peek ||1||
lines.translation: Both the singer and the listener are liberated, when, as Gurmukh, they drink in the Lord's Name, even for an instant. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਟੀਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man har har raam naam ras teek ||
lines.translation: The Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is enshrined within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਰਸੁ ਝੀਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam seetal jal paaiaa har har naam peeaa ras jheek ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, I have obtained the cooling, soothing Water of the Naam. I eagerly drink in the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਊਜਲ ਟੀਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har hiradai preet lagaanee tinaa masatak oojal teek ||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are imbued with the Love of the Lord have the mark of radiant purity upon their foreheads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਡਵਾ ਸਸਿ ਕੀਕ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har jan sobhaa sabh jag oopar jiu vich udavaa sas keek ||2||
lines.translation: The Glory of the Lord's humble servant is manifest throughout the world, like the moon among the stars. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਫੀਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har hiradai naam na vasio tin sabh kaaraj pheek ||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are not filled with the Lord's Name - all their affairs are worthless and insipid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਦੇਹ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਕਟੇ ਨਕ ਕੀਕ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaise seegaar karai deh maanukh naam binaa nakate nak keek ||3||
lines.translation: They may adorn and decorate their bodies, but without the Naam, they look like their noses have been cut off. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਸਭ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਈਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat ramaeeaa ramat raam raai sabh varatai sabh mahi eek ||
lines.translation: The Sovereign Lord permeates each and every heart; the One Lord is all-pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਘਰੀ ਮੀਕ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau har kirapaa dhaaree gur bachan dhiaaio gharee meek ||4||3||
lines.translation: The Lord has showered His Mercy upon servant Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, I have meditated on the Lord in an instant. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮ ਕਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam daiaal kripaa prabh dhaaree mukh har har naam ham kahe ||
lines.translation: God, the Inaccessible and Merciful, has showered me with His Mercy; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan har naam dhiaaio sabh kilabikh paap lahe ||1||
lines.translation: I meditate on the Name of the Lord, the Purifier of sinners; I am rid of all my sins and mistakes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap man raam naam rav rahe ||
lines.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the All-pervading Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal dukh bha(n)jan gaaio guramat naam padaarath lahe ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I sing the Praises of the Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain. Following the Guru's Teachings, I gather in the Wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਨਗਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa nagar nagar har basio mat guramat har har sahe ||
lines.translation: The Lord abides in the body-village; through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord, Har, Har, is revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sareer sarovar naam har pragatio ghar ma(n)dar har prabh lahe ||2||
lines.translation: In the lake of the body, the Lord's Name has been revealed. Within my own home and mansion, I have obtained the Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਉਦਿਆਨੇ ਤੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo nar bharam bharam udiaane te saakat mooR muhe ||
lines.translation: Those beings who wander in the wilderness of doubt - those faithless cynics are foolish, and are plundered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਭਿ ਬਸੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਨਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਝਾਰ ਗਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu mrig naabh basai baas basanaa bhram bhramio jhaar gahe ||3||
lines.translation: They are like the deer: the scent of musk comes from its own navel, but it wanders and roams around, searching for it in the bushes. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum vad agam agaadh bodh prabh mat devahu har prabh lahe ||
lines.translation: You are Great and Unfathomable; Your Wisdom, God, is Profound and Incomprehensible. Please bless me with that wisdom, by which I might attain You, O Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau gur haath sir dhario har raam naam rav rahe ||4||4||
lines.translation: The Guru has placed His Hand upon servant Nanak; he chants the Name of the Lord. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਡਫਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man laagee preet raam naam har har japio har prabh vadaphaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is in love with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; I meditate on the Great Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਫਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bachan sukhaane heearai har dhaaree har prabh kripaphaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Word of the True Guru has become pleasing to my heart. The Lord God has showered me with His Grace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man bhaj raam naam har nimakhaphaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord's Name every instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸਫਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har daan deeo gur poorai har naamaa man tan basaphaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with the gift of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The Lord's Name abides in my mind and body. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਵਸਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਪਫਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa nagar vasio ghar ma(n)dar jap sobhaa guramukh karapaphaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord abides in the body-village, in my home and mansion. As Gurmukh, I meditate on His Glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰਫਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat jan bhae suhele mukh oojal guramukh taraphaa ||2||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, the Lord's humble servants are embellished and exalted; their faces are radiant; as Gurmukh, they are carried across. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਫਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anabhau har har har liv laagee har ur dhaario gur nimakhaphaa ||
lines.translation: I am lovingly attuned to the Fearless Lord, Har, Har, Har; through the Guru, I have enshrined the Lord within my heart in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੇ ਦੋਖ ਸਭ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਇਕ ਪਲਫਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kot kot ke dokh sabh jan ke har door keee ik palaphaa ||3||
lines.translation: Millions upon millions of the faults and mistakes of the Lord's humble servant are all taken away in an instant. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਮੁਖਫਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumare jan tum hee te jaane prabh jaanio jan te mukhaphaa ||
lines.translation: Your humble servants are known only through You, God; knowing You, they becomes supreme.
